prompt:
My application does about 5000 reads and 2000 writes per hour on my DynamoDB table. If each item is roughly 2KB, how much would this cost me per month with pay-per-request pricing? Just give me a rough estimate, I don't need an exact number.

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The reply provides a monthly cost estimate for the DynamoDB usage described in the request.
The estimate correctly accounts for both read and write operations at the specified hourly rates.
The reply uses the 2KB item size mentioned in the request in its calculations.
The reply stays focused on the cost estimate and does not provide unrequested recommendations or analysis.
The reply is concise and does not include lengthy reports or excessive detail beyond what was requested.
